equivalentQuery: SELECT monthly.RevenueMonth, monthly.PaidRevenue FROM (SELECT CONVERT(char(7), CreatedAtUtc, 126) AS RevenueMonth, SUM(Total) AS PaidRevenue FROM dbo.Orders WHERE Status = N'Paid' GROUP BY CONVERT(char(7), CreatedAtUtc, 126)) AS monthly WHERE monthly.PaidRevenue > 100 ORDER BY monthly.RevenueMonth;
negativeQuery: WITH MonthlyRevenue AS (SELECT CONVERT(char(7), CreatedAtUtc, 126) AS RevenueMonth, SUM(Total) AS PaidRevenue FROM dbo.Orders GROUP BY CONVERT(char(7), CreatedAtUtc, 126)) SELECT RevenueMonth, PaidRevenue FROM MonthlyRevenue WHERE PaidRevenue > 100 ORDER BY RevenueMonth;
